candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST 503s and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or saturation counters; pool size 5/idle 0 is inferred from client span attributes only.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests return 502 after ~2s; traces show order POST ReadTimeout and postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable while pool size=5 and idle=0, consistent with pool exhaustion at the order service. Redis and payment calls succeed, so downstream latency and redis-timeout are less supported.
